sources.citation: SIL Language & Culture Archives, search results for fll (2015, 2022 snapshots) and fal (2022 snapshot).
sources.note: Catalogue only: fll has exactly one item (Ennulat 1976 data sheet); fal has Ennulat & Ennulat 1971 phonology of Ram, Ennulat 1978 discourse paper, eight 1973-74 primers. Sweetman 1981 is not in the SIL online archive.

sources.citation: Adamawa Languages Project (JGU Mainz), pages 'Adamawa languages' and 'Publications' (Kramer 2011, 2014, 2018 on Fali).
sources.note: Nothing on stress; bibliography only. Kramer's Fali papers (2011 demonstratives; 2018 clause-final marker ɓɐ) are on Fali of Boulgou (South Fali) and are morphosyntactic.

sources.citation: Kramer, Raija. 2014. Die Sprache der Fali in Nordkamerun: Eine funktionale Beschreibung (Grammatische Analysen Afrikanischer Sprachen 45). Köln: Rüdiger Köppe. 344 pp. Publisher preview pp. 1-78.
sources.access_detail: copy on file; access check: library print copy (Scan & Deliver or loan): WID Offsite Storage PL8026.F26 K73 2014
sources.note: Nothing on stress. Describes the Fali of Boulgou = Fali-Tinguelin (South Fali, sout2782), not North Fali. Ch. 2 (pp. 31-64): no lexical tonal oppositions ('Im Fali treten keine tonalen Oppositionen bei Lexemen auf'), two grammatical register tones on verb forms; p. 64 'Prosodie ist kein Gegenstand dieser Arbeit'; no Akzent/Betonung statement in pp. 1-78. Introduction (pp. 5-20) gives the dialect geography: North Fali = Peske-Bori (Bvari), Bossoum, Dourbeye; Ram (Ennulat's variety) is the NE dialect of Fali-Tinguelin; research inventory lists only wordlists (Strümpell 1910, 1922-23; Lukas 1937…

sources.citation: Lewis, Simons & Fennig (eds.). 2014. Ethnologue 17th ed., entry 'Fali, North' (fll) (Wayback snapshot).
sources.note: Nothing on stress. 16,000 speakers (1982 SIL); Mayo-Louti division, Dourbeye and Mayo-Oulo area; dialects Bossoum (Bonum), Bveri (Bori, Fali du Peske-Bori, Peske), Dourbeye; 'Unwritten'; rapidly shifting to Fulfulde.

sources.citation: Wiktionary. Appendix: Proto-Fali reconstructions (from Sweetman 1981), rev. 2020-08-02.
sources.note: Nothing on stress; reconstructions carry no tone or accent marks. Records Sweetman's split: Southern dialects Ram, Kangou, Ndoudja, Toro, Ngoutchoumi (Bélé); Northern dialects Peske, Bori, Boussoum, Dourbeye.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.3, languoid nort2770 North Fali; Wikipedia 'Fali languages (Cameroon)'; CrossRef, archive.org and Google Books feed searches.
sources.note: Nothing on stress. Glottolog and Wikipedia name Sweetman 1981 as the only descriptive source; CrossRef/archive.org/Google Books turned up no phonological description of Adamawa Fali (only ethnography: Lebeuf 1961; the 2024 'Nigerian Fali' intelligibility paper concerns Chadic Fali, fli).

sources.note: The only work Glottolog types as phonology for fll; compares nine dialects including the northern Peske, Bori, Boussoum and Dourbeye and reconstructs Proto-Fali phonemes, so it is the one place a statement on North Fali prosody (tone/stress) could exist. Hammarström holds a private scan (bestfn).
